'''Barlin Fugar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]], who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Fugar was a member of the [[Intarsa League]], a criminal organization that operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. When the League captured the [[Blue Star Centre]], on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], in about [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Fugar took up a defensive position in one of the Centre's office buildings. He believed that he and his fellow criminals were in a dangerous situation, which could only resolved by a show of force. He also thought that the situation had been caused by [[Dersa Welles]], the leader of the League, and [[Corkash Fenc]], a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] soldier, who were not doing their jobs properly.
